set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/archive. Acceptance: replace bag-like TransformDescriptor with typed transform descriptor variants and a derivable required transform plan; add typed ArchiveDatasetPath/RunScopedPath so run membership is not inferred by string prefix; split Payload.IntMatrix storage into UInt8/UInt16/Int32 or equivalent validated storage contracts; type checksums, storage format ids, shared basis kind/params/timestamps; make validation errors carry structured issues. Verification: archiveJVM/test and archiveJS/test plus HDF store roundtrips where JVM payload contracts change.
set.title: Type archive manifests, transform descriptors, payload storage, and validation
